title: Montrose Environmental Group, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Montrose Environmental Group, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 17, 2026 announcing a corporate name change to Onterris, Inc., effective immediately upon filing with the Delaware Secretary of State. The company's common stock will begin trading under the new name and ticker symbol ONT on NYSE on May 4, 2026. No changes were made to voting rights, share validity, transferability, or the company's CUSIP number.
